hero.title: Your Private AI Knowledge Vault
hero.subtitle: The private Pocket alternative for read-it-later: bookmarks, notes and documents — encrypted locally, searchable by AI, synced peer-to-peer. Zero cloud. Zero tracking. 100% yours.

pocketAlternative.title: The Private Pocket Alternative
pocketAlternative.subtitle: Pocket is going away. BookmarkForge keeps the read-it-later habit alive — with every article, note and highlight stored encrypted on your device.

features.title: Read It Later, Yours Forever
features.text: Save articles, videos and PDFs with one click — from the PWA, browser extension or share menu. Unlike Pocket, your reading list lives on your device, encrypted, and still works offline.

features.title: Notion-Style Notes on Every Article
features.text: Highlight, summarize and take block-based notes attached to any bookmark. Turn a saved article into your own knowledge base — not just a link list.

features.title: Zero Tracking, Zero Ads
features.text: BookmarkForge has no accounts, no analytics and no ads by default. Your reading habits are nobody's business but yours.

features.title: Powerful features for knowledge management, all running locally

items.title: Bookmarks & Documents
items.text: Save any page with one click. Rich block editor (Notion-style) for notes. Virtualized lists handle 100k+ items smoothly.

items.title: Full-Text & Semantic Search
items.text: Search by keyword or meaning. Vector embeddings (HNSW) find related content even without exact matches.

items.title: Local AI (WebLLM / Ollama) — Pro only
items.text: Run Llama 3.2, Phi-3, TinyLlama entirely in your browser via WebGPU. Zero data leaves your device. Requires Pro ($79 lifetime).

items.title: RAG Chat Over Your Data — Pro only
items.text: Ask questions and get answers grounded in YOUR bookmarks and notes. Citations included. Private mode = 100% local. Requires Pro.

items.title: P2P Sync (WebRTC) — Pro only
items.text: Sync vaults between your devices directly. No central server. Encrypted end-to-end. QR pairing in seconds. Up to 3 devices with Pro.

items.title: Encrypted Backups
items.text: Daily automatic .bmf backups. Manual export to Markdown, JSON, CSV, PDF. Restore in seconds. You hold the keys.

items.title: Knowledge Graph
items.text: Visualize connections between your notes and bookmarks. Filter by tags, dates, similarity. Zoom and pan infinite canvas.

items.title: Flashcards (Spaced Repetition) — Pro only
items.text: Generate cards from any document. Anki-style SR algorithm schedules reviews at optimal intervals. Great for learning. Requires Pro.

items.title: Privacy by Default
items.text: No analytics, no tracking, no accounts. Optional opt-in telemetry only. GDPR compliant. You are the controller.

ai.title: Your Knowledge, Amplified
ai.subtitle: BookmarkForge gives you options: run models 100% locally in your browser (WebLLM, WebGPU) with Pro, connect your own API keys for cloud providers, or use local Ollama. Your prompts, your data, your rules.

list.name: Local WebLLM (TinyLlama, Llama-3.2-1B/3B, Phi-3.5-mini) — Pro only
Custom / OpenRouter via custom provider (your API key)

items.title: Private Mode
items.text: Local AI only (WebLLM/Ollama). Zero data leaves device. Works offline. Requires Pro for WebLLM.

items.title: Web Search Mode
items.text: Combines your vault with live search results (cloud providers).

items.title: Expert Agents
items.text: Specialized personas: Coder, Writer, Analyst, Researcher. Requires Pro for local AI.

privacy.title: Privacy Isn't a Feature — It's the Foundation
privacy.subtitle: Every architectural decision puts you in control

items.title: End-to-End Encryption
items.text: AES-256-GCM with keys derived from your master password via Argon2id. We never see your password or keys.

items.title: Local-First Architecture
items.text: Your vault lives in IndexedDB on your device. The companion server only handles AI proxy, licensing, and signaling — never your content.

items.title: Zero Telemetry by Default
items.text: No analytics, no crash reports, no tracking. Optional opt-in for aggregated usage stats and error reporting — each independently controlled.

items.title: You Hold the Keys
items.text: Device key separation: JWK in localStorage + ciphertexts in IndexedDB. Both required. No master password = no access. No "forgot password" backdoor.

items.title: GDPR Compliant
items.text: Granular consent (analytics, error reporting, client events). Right to access, rectify, erase, port — all doable locally. ROPA documented.

items.title: No Vendor Lock-in
items.text: Export your data anytime in open formats (JSON, Markdown, CSV, PDF). Your knowledge stays portable.

pricing.title: Simple, Fair Pricing — No Subscriptions
pricing.subtitle: Free 1,000 bookmarks forever. Pro is a Lifetime license for v1 — pay once, own v1 forever. Includes all v1.x updates and 12 months of feature updates. Security updates forever. No monthly billing.

items.question: Is the Free tier really free forever?
items.answer: Yes. No trial, no subscription. The free tier includes 1,000 bookmarks, full-text & semantic search, knowledge graph, and AI with your own API key (you pay the provider).

items.question: What does "Lifetime of v1" mean for Pro?
items.answer: Pay once, own v1 forever. Includes all v1.x updates (bugfixes + minor features) forever and 12 months of feature updates from purchase. Security updates forever. After month 13 you keep v1 functional, just without new features. Future major versions (v2, v3) are separate products: $89 for new customers, $35 for v1 owners (60% off).

items.question: What about Founder Edition?
items.answer: Same Pro v1 binary — not a feature tier. Founder gives you a Founder # badge in the app, beta access to v2, and 60% off future majors forever for this account. Limited 100. Vanity, not paywall.

items.question: What payment methods & refunds?
items.answer: Via Whop: credit card, PayPal, crypto. We never see your payment details. 30-day refund — contact bookmarkforge@proton.me.

items.question: Support — how fast do you answer?
items.answer: Free: Community help via Help Center + GitHub Discussions (best effort). Pro: email 48h business days. Founder: priority 24h + beta queue. Vault is encrypted — we cannot see your data, so we never ask for your password or recovery phrase. See Support SLA.

items.question: What if I forget my vault password?
items.answer: We cannot recover it. When you create a vault we show 24-word recovery phrase once — write it on paper. Without it, no one (including us) can open the vault. See BF-E101.
